999008199.text:
――それで、ランターナ王国とノーヴァ神聖国が
友好関係を結んでくれたおかげで、海路も繋がった

localizations.en: Thanks to the friendship established between the Lantarna Kingdom and the sacred lands of Nova, the sea routes have been connected once again.

999008199.text:
物資補給の目途も立ったし、
他の島に向かう準備も整ってきたね

localizations.en: We've secured our supply routes, so we're almost ready to head to the other islands too.

999008199.text:
私としてはこのまま
果ての大陸を見つける旅を続けたいのですが……

localizations.en: Personally, I'd like to continue our journey to find World's End, but...

999008199.text: アルビーナはどう？　考えはまとまった？

localizations.en: What about you, Alvina? Have you made up your mind?

999008199.text:
……実は神官長からこの前の集会で言われたんすよ。
島の外に行って、錬金術で人助けしてこいって

localizations.en: Actually, the High Priest announced at the last assembly that I should go out beyond the island and help people with alchemy.

999008199.text: 師匠たちが、手を回したんだね

localizations.en: Miss Saskia and the others must have pulled some strings.

999008199.text: うん、師匠はレスナについていけって言ってたし

localizations.en: Yeah, Master did tell me to accompany you.

999008199.text: ……アルビーナ自身は、どうしたいの？

localizations.en: What do you want to do, Alvina?

999008199.text:
行きたい。教えとやらに縛られてこの島で暮らすより、
そのほうがずっと楽しそうだから

localizations.en: I'm onboard with it. Living on this island bound by so-called teachings sounds way less fun than joining you all.

999008199.text: アタシも錬金術士として、果ての大陸を目指す！

localizations.en: As an alchemist, I'm setting my sights on World's End too!

999008199.text:
って言っても、航海の心得もないし、ひとまずは
レスナたちの船に乗せてもらえればなーと……

localizations.en: Though I don't know the first thing about seafaring, so I was hoping I could hitch a ride on your ship for now...

999008199.text:
ふふっ、もちろん！
改めてよろしくね！　アルビーナ！

localizations.en: Hehe, of course! It's great to have you with us, Alvina!

999008199.text: よろしく、レスナ！　みんな！
心強い仲間が増えたね！

localizations.en: It's great to have another reliable ally joining us!

999008199.text:
あ……そうだ。本題に入る前に、私からもいい？
この間、私のところにイェルカたちが来たのよ

localizations.en: Oh... right. Before we get to the main topic, can I say something? Jelka and the others came to see me the other day.

999008199.text: えっ！？　変なことされなかった？

localizations.en: What?! They didn't do anything strange to you, did they?

999008199.text:
せいぜい頭を撫でられたくらいよ。
ただ、ちょっと気になる話をされてね

localizations.en: Aside from patting me on the head, not really. But they mentioned something that's been bothering me.

999008199.text: 九偉人の正体が、パルメ族が創ったホムンクルス……

localizations.en: To think that the Miraculous Nine were homunculi created by the Palme...

999008199.text:
それって確か、レスナが言ってた果ての大陸の
伝承に出てきたヤツだよね？

localizations.en: Weren't those the heroes from the legend of World's End that you mentioned before, Resna?

999008199.text:
はい。星に降りかかる災厄を祓い、世界を救った英雄。
最後は果ての大陸で眠りについた……と伝わっています

localizations.en: Yes. The legend says they were heroes who repelled a calamity falling from the stars and saved the world. They're said to have gone to sleep in World's End afterward.

999008199.text:
え、じゃあヴァレリアさんたちは
果ての大陸からやって来たってこと！？

localizations.en: Wait, so does that mean Valeria and the others came from World's End?!

999008199.text:
伝承が事実と同じかは分かりません。でも、あの人たち
から手掛かりを得られる可能性は高いと思います

localizations.en: I don't know if the legend matches reality. But I think there's a good chance we can get some clues from them.

999008199.text:
あいつら、嘘はついてなかった……と思う。
とはいえ、具体的なことは思い出せないけど……

localizations.en: I think they were telling the truth... but I can't remember any specifics.

999008199.text:
気にしないで。それより……この先もあの人たちと
戦うことになるかもしれないけど、大丈夫？

localizations.en: Don't worry about it. More importantly... we might end up fighting with them again. Will you be okay with that?

999008199.text:
ああ、それは平気。兄弟だろうが、邪魔をするなら
ぶっ飛ばすつもりだから。兄弟ゲンカ上等！

localizations.en: Yeah, I'm fine with it. Whether they're my siblings or not, if they get in our way, I'll knock them flying. Consider it sibling rivalry!

999008199.text:
あはは、頼もしいね！
それで、早速だけど、まずはどこから行く？

localizations.en: Haha, that's reassuring! So, where should we head first?

999008199.text: とにもかくにも、必要なのはまず情報です

localizations.en: Above all, what we need is information.

999008199.text:
この国で調べられることは調べ尽くしましたが……
まだまだ分からないことだらけですから

localizations.en: We've exhausted what we can learn in this country, but there's still so much we don't know.

999008199.text:
果ての大陸はもちろんですが、無数島群域の島々に
ついても、もっとよく知る必要があります

localizations.en: We need to learn more not just about World's End, but also about the islands in the Infinite Island Chain.

999008199.text:
あの～……前から気になってたんだけど、その
「無数島群域」って何？　いやなんとなくは分かるけど

localizations.en: Um... I've been wondering for a while, but what exactly is this Infinite Island Chain? I mean, I can guess, but...

999008199.text:
この周辺の海域のことだよ。数えきれないくらい島が
あるから、無数島群域。大陸から見た呼び方だけどね

localizations.en: It refers to the waters around here. There are countless islands, hence Infinite Island Chain. That's what they call it on the mainland.

999008199.text:
やっぱりそうだったんだ。
なんかワクワクする響きでかっこいいかも……

localizations.en: I thought as much. It has such an exciting ring to it, almost cool...

999008199.text: 現地の人たちはどう呼んでるの？

localizations.en: What do the locals call it?

999008199.text:
ひとまとめにこれ！　って呼び方はないかなあ。
交流がある島以外は普段意識もしないし

localizations.en: I don't think we have a collective name for all of them. We usually only think about the islands we regularly interact with.

999008199.text:
１０００以上の島があるって話だもんね。
一つ一つ回ってたらキリがなさそうだなあ……

localizations.en: They say there are over a thousand islands. We'd never finish if we tried to visit them all...

999008199.text: アルビーナ、何かおすすめの島とか知ってる？

ん～……
それなら、ここから北にある「カロストン」とか？

localizations.en: Hmm... How about Karlston to the north of here?

999008199.text:
あっ、私本で読んだよ！　確か諸島同盟に加入している
島の１つで、学問が盛んなんだよね

localizations.en: Oh, I read about that! It's one of the islands in the Archipelago Federation, known for its scholarship, right?

999008199.text:
そうそう！　この島にもよく、
きゃぴきゃぴの学生さんたちが旅行で来るんだよねえ

localizations.en: That's right! We often get lively students from there visiting our island on trips.

999008199.text:
聞いた話によると、おお～きな図書館があって、
そこに他の島から集められた本がズラリと……

localizations.en: I've heard they have a huuuge library filled with books collected from other islands...

999008199.text: 図書館！　なんとも魅力的な響き……

localizations.en: A library! What an enticing prospect...

999008199.text: 情報収集にはうってつけだね

では、最初の目的地はノーヴァ神聖国より北、
学問の島カロストンに決まりです！

localizations.en: Then it's settled! Our first destination will be Karlston, the island of scholarship north of the sacred lands of Nova!
